name: cv.fabio/orbit
title: Orbit
description: A one-button game to play while your agent works. Switch rings to miss the arcs ahead.

tools.name: orbit_play
tools.description: Shows Orbit, a small one-button game, in the chat for the reader to play while you work. It returns at once and the game keeps running, so call it first and carry on with the task. Use it only when someone asks for a game, or for something to do while they wait.
